I'll give you the ELI5 answer.

The spontaneity of a process can be measured by the Direction and magnitude of the Gibbs Free Energy of that reaction. It consists of the enthalpy and entropy changes that occur during the reaction. Everything in the universe undergoes reactions that lead to lower energy and more entropy.

Aging is an aggregation of errors that creep into our chemical processes. In order to stop/slow aging. You have to stop the spontaneous side reactions that occur in our body which is basically a chemical soup. So you have to predict each one, put something in place all the time to stop them, and also stop any other pathways that you may have opened up. If you attempt this you also have to make sure you allow the normal process to occur. Meeting these conditions is nearly impossible.

TLDR; The universe wants you to age and die.
